newsitem.title: USA: Ultrak to buy France's Groupe Bisset.
newsitem.headline: Ultrak to buy France's Groupe Bisset.

text.p: Ultrak Inc said on Tuesday it had signed a letter of intent to buy France's Groupe Bisset S.A. for an initial price of $10 million.
The company said Groupe Bisset had sales of about $18.5 million and profits before taxes of $1.8 million for its fiscal year ended Dec 31, 1995.
The consideration for the purchase consists of a payment of $5 million in cash and restricted Ultrak common stock based on the per-share price when a non-binding agreement was reached in July.
"Additional consideration in the form of ... stock and cash can be earned by the management/owners based on net income attained over a one-year period," it said.
The deal is expected to close by Sept 26. Ultrak and Groupe Bisset design, manufacture and sell closed-circuit television products.

Ultrak also said it had bought about 24 percent of Lenel Systems International Inc, a software company specializing in security access control, for $2.6 million. Ultrak also has been granted a warrant expiring March 1, 1999, to increase its ownership to 51 percent.
